card.name: Words leading up to ties or relationships
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected noun like ties, links, relationships or connections, in text about countries, groups or people. Often an adjective such as close, commercial or historic, or a verb like had or severed.

modes.label: Adjective before ties
modes.description: An adjective such as close, commercial or historic that modifies an upcoming word for ties or relationships.
modes.example: The Indian subcontinent has had<< close>> commercial ties with the Gulf for centuries,

modes.label: Verb leading to a connection
modes.description: A verb such as had, have, severed or develop that is about to take ties, contact or links as its object.
modes.example: Many friends<< severed>> ties with them.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words meaning ties, links or connections next.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a coming mention of ties or relationships between countries or people.
